findings.text: The map: most cells are ties between trackers (39 of the 55 cells where any tracker passes). In 8 of 63 cells nothing works even at zero delay, all with 30 to 50 % bursty loss (`runs/s6-atlas`).

limits: imm and ct are the two turn-aware arms; the turn sweep found no single best one
A cell can fail on the max-error rule even when its median p95 does not exceed the p95 threshold.
A failing cell where no removal applies (delay, loss and noise already 0) is labelled model-mismatch.
An interval end of "<0" means the Wilson bound already reaches 0.5 at delay 0, so even 0 s may not be tolerated.

s6.cell_label_rule: a cell is labelled fails when at least half of its seeds fail, otherwise passes
s6.criterion: a seed fails when its scored-window p95 error exceeds 0.25 m or its maximum error exceeds 0.5 m (a research criterion, not a safety limit)

findings.text: A basic tracker's error grows by about speed x delay. Its p95 error (the error it stays under 95 % of the time) crosses the 0.25 m line at 200 ms of delay with no loss, for a 1 m/s target, 10 Hz measurements, 5 cm noise and 50 seeds. The 200 ms depends on the sensor noise (the filter is always told 5 cm): with 0 or 2 cm it still passes at 200 ms and first fails at 300 ms (the next delay tested), and with 10 cm it fails from 150 ms (`runs/s6-recovery`).

Stamping each measurement with the time it was taken, then predicting forward, cuts the 300 ms error with no loss from 0.36 m to 0.16 m on a straight line, and from 0.38 m to 0.29 m on a 1 m radius turn (`runs/s6-recovery`).
On the turn, lost packets matter more than delay: at 30 % random loss the recovery tracker fails from 150 ms just like the basic one, and at 50 % both fail at every delay (`runs/s6-recovery`).

s6.interval_note: distribution-free 95% order-statistic interval for medians (for 50 seeds the 18th and 33rd smallest values, coverage 96.7%; with 5 or fewer seeds it falls back to min and max) and Wilson 95% interval for failure rates
limits: simulated link and sensor (synthetic, not measured)
recovery drops late out-of-order packets (no retrodiction)
fixed tuning: measurement std 0.05 m (R = 0.0025 m^2) and q = 0.1 m^2/s^3, except the labelled oracle slice
targets at 1.0 m/s, turn radius 1.0 m
criterion is a research choice, not a safety limit
s6.status: synthetic investigation: simulated link and sensor, not flight performance
